title: Lagrange realism: HDR display output (EDR on iOS)
body: Deferred from #9802 (candidate C13 in docs/research/unreal/2026-09-27-lagrange-realism-audit.md). The physical renderer tone-maps to an sRGB surface. HDR output needs an extended-range surface format, native layer configuration on iOS (CAMetalLayer EDR) and macOS, an output transform that targets display peak luminance (ITU-R BT.2100 / ACES 2.0 style), and validation on a physical device.
